agents.name: Analyst
agents.doing: Research done: 9 findings across both channels

log.msg: Ambient Escape: a 3-hour crackling fireplace video is running 4x its channel average — fireplace season has started.
Bounce Theory: soft-body '0% vs 100%' (3.5M, 37x) and cloth sims are today's biggest outliers; your melody + string-art Shorts lead your own stats.
Team hired. First run is scheduled.

items.title: Metallic Cloth Takes Over a Red Ball 😍 | Satisfying 3D Simulation
items.creator: MORPHIK 3D
items.whyItWorks: One object slowly 'consuming' another is a pure watch-to-the-end hook; deformable materials (cloth/jelly) read as premium vs rigid balls. Channel: Bounce Theory.

items.title: Verity 0% vs 100% Soft Body Simulation 😱
items.creator: ArtikAnimates
items.whyItWorks: '0% vs 100%' comparison promises a visible payoff and invites viewers to wait for the extreme case. Soft-body is a format Bounce Theory doesn't have yet. Channel: Bounce Theory.

items.title: Bouncing Emoji Balls Multiply in a Spiral! Satisfying Chain Reaction Simulation
items.creator: GreyHaT Sim
items.whyItWorks: Multiplying balls work when the arena itself adds novelty (a spiral) — Omar's plain '1 ball becomes 200' got 2 views, so the multiply mechanic needs a new container. Channel: Bounce Theory.

items.title: Guess The Song// Satisfying physics simulation - 999 varied bouncing orbs
items.creator: Mo Lucky
items.whyItWorks: Melody-on-collision + 'guess the song' framing; matches Omar's own best Short ('This ball plays a song you know', 867 views). Channel: Bounce Theory.

items.title: Marble Run ☆ Freedom Marble Run①
items.creator: Marble Run Freedom
items.whyItWorks: Marble runs are the biggest raw-view outliers in the scan (also 'CARRERA DE CANICAS ELIGE TU COLOR FAVORITO!!' 3.3M, pick-your-colour hook). Channel: Bounce Theory.

items.title: Done for the Day? Kick Back with This Real Crackling Fireplace 4K (3 Hours)
items.creator: Novaden
items.whyItWorks: Seasonal (late October) fireplace demand; the title sells an evening ritual ('Done for the day?') instead of just 'fireplace'. Channel: Ambient Escape.

items.title: Layered ASMR | Mic Brushing, Rain Sounds & Hand Movements | No Talking
items.creator: The Kraken ASMR
items.whyItWorks: 'Layered' + 'No Talking' signals a stacked, uninterrupted sound bed — supports Ambient Escape's multi-layer mixes and putting the layers in the title. Channel: Ambient Escape.

items.title: The Question That Leaves Every Soul Silent
items.creator: Tartil Offical
items.whyItWorks: Curiosity-question title for an Islamic reflection outperforms its channel; question-led hooks fit Ambient Escape's quiz/reminder Shorts. Channel: Ambient Escape.

items.title: Rain Downpour 10 Hours, Black Screen Rain NO THUNDER, Heavy Rain Sounds For Sleeping
items.creator: Still Point
items.whyItWorks: Long sleep titles stack exclusions ('Black Screen', 'NO THUNDER') so light-sensitive or easily-startled sleepers know exactly what they get. Channel: Ambient Escape.
